articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a 1M-token context window. The model demonstrates substantial gains on graduate-level science benchmarks and complex agentic coding tasks, narrowing the gap between AI assistants and domain specialists in fields like molecular biology and legal analysis.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics Models Enable Dexterous Manipulation in Unstructured Environments
articles.summary: DeepMind published results from its Gemini Robotics program showing foundation-model-driven robot hands performing multi-step assembly tasks in cluttered, novel environments with minimal prompt engineering. The system leverages a vision-language-action architecture that generalizes across object geometries not seen during training, marking a significant step toward general-purpose robotic manipulation.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Tool-Use Orchestration for Enterprise Agentic Workflows
articles.summary: Anthropic announced a new agentic orchestration layer for its Claude model family that allows enterprises to compose multi-step tool-use pipelines with built-in safety guardrails and audit logging. The system supports human-in-the-loop checkpoints and granular permission scoping, addressing key concerns around autonomous AI agents operating in production financial and healthcare environments.

articles.title: Figure and BMW Expand Humanoid Robot Deployment to Full Vehicle Assembly Lines
articles.summary: Figure AI announced the expansion of its humanoid robot deployment at BMW's Spartanburg plant, moving beyond pilot cells to full integration in body-in-white and final assembly lines. The robots handle tasks including wire harness routing and quality inspection, operating alongside human workers with a shared safety-rated workspace protocol.

articles.title: Meta Releases Open-Source Llama 4 Models with Mixture-of-Experts at 400B Parameters
articles.summary: Meta released the Llama 4 family of open-weight models featuring a mixture-of-experts architecture with up to 400 billion total parameters but only 52 billion active per forward pass. The models rival proprietary frontier systems on code generation and multilingual reasoning benchmarks, and Meta is providing them under a permissive license that allows commercial use, intensifying competition in the open-source LLM ecosystem.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 2nm GAA Chips for Next-Generation AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed the start of volume production on its N2 process node using gate-all-around transistor architecture, with initial wafers destined for AI accelerator clients including NVIDIA and Apple. The node delivers approximately 25% higher performance at equivalent power compared to N3E, a critical enabler for next-generation training and inference hardware facing growing power-efficiency constraints.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Reliable Logical Qubit Operations Below Error-Correction Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum published results showing sustained logical qubit operations with error rates below the threshold required for practical fault-tolerant quantum computing, using a hybrid trapped-ion architecture with real-time decoding. This milestone brings commercially relevant quantum computation closer to reality, particularly for materials simulation and cryptographic applications.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Unveils Commercial Atlas Electric Platform with Integrated LLM-Based Task Planning
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics debuted the commercial version of its all-electric Atlas humanoid robot, now featuring an onboard large language model for natural-language task planning and real-time re-planning upon failure detection. The platform targets logistics and industrial inspection use cases, with Hyundai facilities serving as the first commercial deployment sites.
